**Root cause: Northbridge Pay IP allowlist no longer includes the pod's egress IP.**

The `payout-sender` pod itself is healthy (Running, Ready, 0 restarts, unchanged since the May 6 deploy). The failures started Tuesday at 14:30 UTC when the Northbridge API began returning:

```
403 Forbidden {"error":"ip_not_allowlisted","message":"Request origin 34.201.17.88 is not on the IP allowlist for merchant MRC-20931"}
```

Every call since then has returned the same 403. Two batches succeeded earlier that day (batches 8812 and 8813 at 13:30 and 14:00 UTC), so the application code and credentials are fine — something changed on the Northbridge side around 14:30 UTC Tuesday that removed or replaced the allowlist entry for the outbound IP `34.201.17.88` (node `ip-10-0-33-51.ec2.internal`).

**Fix (for treasury ops team to apply in the Northbridge merchant portal):**
Log in to the Northbridge Pay merchant portal for merchant `MRC-20931` and add `34.201.17.88` to the IP allowlist. Once that is done, the queued batches will be retried automatically (the sender is already requeuing them, currently at attempt 43/72 for the oldest batch, with ~2,187 payouts across 38 batches queued).
